diagnostics.message: The `aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook` stage has `auto_deploy = true`, but Terraform only orders it after the `aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook` (via `api_id`). Nothing forces the stage to be created after `aws_apigatewayv2_route.webhook` (and its integration), so on a fresh apply the stage may deploy before the `POST /webhook` route exists — the resulting auto-deployment will not contain the route, leaving the webhook endpoint returning 404 until another deployment is triggered. The stage needs an ordering guarantee on the route; since the stage exposes no attribute that can reference the route, an explicit `depends_on = [aws_apigatewayv2_route.webhook]` is the appropriate fix.
